name: Summer of Love
source:
2020, a new bright decade! At least that was what people thought. The virus destroyed everything. You lost your job as a yoga instructor. But it was lucky for you that another yoga center in a small town hired you. You moved there with your girlfriend, who was also a yoga instructor. One day, she asked you if you could let a guy work there with you. And your mother also asked you if you could let her boyfriend stay with you when she was busy helping people in the global pandemic.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/captainkitty]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
2020年，一个光明的新时代开始了！至少人们原本如此以为。病毒毁掉了一切，你也失去了瑜伽教练的工作。幸运的是，一座小镇的另一家瑜伽中心雇用了你。你与同为瑜伽教练的女友一起搬了过去。某天，她问你，能否让一个男人与你们一起工作。而母亲也问你，当她忙着在全球大流行病期间帮助他人时，能否让自己的男友暂住你家。
